title: Spread a liquid sample and close an agar plate
context: Spread plating is a routine manual preparation step in research microbiology. The task isolates handling the lid and standard T-spreader while distributing a finite liquid sample without gouging the gel. A coloured nonliving stand-in permits repeated physical trials; microbial growth and sterile technique are outside this task.
setup: One92×16mm nominal Petri dish:base outer diameter89mm with1mm floor and15mm wall, lid92mm with1mm roof and12mm skirt;86.8mm diameter,5mm thick plain 1.50% w/w agar-water gel;100 µL of 2.00 mg/mL Brilliant Blue FCF in water at its centre. One140×35mm nominal T-spreader with4mm shaft/bar diameter, on three passive rests. Dish centre(330,40,747.5)mm; tool shaft centre(430,-120,803.5)mm. Base28g,lid8g,tool2.1g. Four black cardinal ink ticks on the base rim define the grading quadrants.
scoring: Released closed dish upright on the table and spreader released on its rack, all still for1s:1.0 for at least85% wet coverage of the central80mm circle and at least75% in each quadrant;0.5 for50% overall;0.25 for25%;otherwise0. Any gouged area of1mm² or more, or interarm collision,gives0. Final state.
fidelity: Native rigid92mm dish and140×35mm T-tool with compliant gel contact. A finite100µL grid transfers liquid with tool contact and motion; tool capacity10µL. T-bar indentation and native gel contacts from robot/lid/tool witness approximate damage at0.3mm. Gravity drainage is reduced-order. No growth, sterility or calibrated gel rheology/CFD; dimensions,masses and gel coefficients are engineering approximations.
instruction: Spread the predispensed liquid suspension across the central 80 mm diameter of the agar plate using the T-shaped spreader. Avoid gouging the agar. Return and release the tool on its rack, then replace and release the dish lid. Leave the dish closed and stable.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0/4000 actions/200 s; scripted demo: 1.0/3540 actions/177 s
reset_notes: Use one fresh covered plate per run from the same batch of NOW 6410 plain agar gel. Use fresh same-day Brilliant Blue FCF tracer (Supelco 80717), the same 22 ± 1 °C trial temperature and a clean dry tool. Drop 100 µL at the centre, replace the lid and start 10 ± 2 s after dispensing. Photograph coverage within 10 s after the final hold. See PHYSICAL_GRADING.md for the batch recipe, plate age and handling.
